name: scaffold-type-formatting
goal: Generated implementations and sibling type files pass the project formatter after declaration extraction

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: CLI lib generation fails its unchanged check: declaration extraction emits extra blank lines in runtime and type files.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing all-scaffold matrix checked paths and export targets but not emitted formatting; extend it to check every generated TypeScript file with the generated project formatter.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Immutable 6b722a7e8b925cf6648d2c4c7974a7120d50c77a30217a5140a86f29586001b6 fails the standard all-scaffold formatter assertion at test-only fb4f918558a382b1560370ca52d75a30fd6f6d1a.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Trim extracted declaration boundaries, preserve intentional interior text, and wrap generated model type imports at the declared project width.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
